clusters.headline: Government Proposes 50% Seat Hike and Women’s Quota in New Bill
aiSummaryBullets: The proposed Delimitation (Second) Bill, 2026, aims to increase parliamentary and state assembly seats by 50%.
New provisions include a one-third reservation quota for women in the Lok Sabha and state assemblies.

clusters.headline: Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh Arrested Over Harassment Complaint
aiSummaryBullets: Kallakurichi TVK MLA Arul Vignesh was arrested by police following a harassment complaint filed by a woman IAS officer.
The case involves charges under the Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act and the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Issues Contempt Notices Over Tirupparankundram Deepam
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court mandated that the Karthigai Deepam lamp be lit at Tirupparankundram hill under police protection.
Contempt notices were issued to state officials for failing to follow previous directives regarding the lighting ceremony.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Quashes Bihar Move To Release Anand Mohan From Prison
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court ruled that the Bihar government's decision to grant premature release to former MP Anand Mohan was illegal.
Anand Mohan was previously granted release during his sentence for a murder case, a move now overturned by the top court.

clusters.headline: Bombay High Court Rules On Property Dispute Over Gift Deed
aiSummaryBullets: An 88-year-old father moved into an old-age home after transferring property to his son.
The Bombay High Court intervened in the subsequent dispute regarding the gifted flat.

clusters.headline: Political Clash Intensifies Across India On Constitution Day
aiSummaryBullets: The BJP and Congress engaged in mutual accusations of undermining constitutional values during commemorations.
Union Minister Amit Shah criticized Congress leadership regarding the status of the Women's Reservation Bill.

clusters.headline: Amritpal Singh, Breakaway Akali Groups And BJP Negotiate Alliance
aiSummaryBullets: Amritpal Singh is reportedly planning to contest Punjab assembly seats while negotiating a regional alliance.
The BJP and Shiromani Akali Dal have formed a renewed partnership to compete in the upcoming 2027 state elections.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Orders Karthigai Deepam To Be Lit At Deepathoon
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court mandated that the Karthigai Deepam lamp be lit at the designated Deepathoon site.
The court suspended the temple's board of trustees and appointed receivers to manage the temple operations.

clusters.headline: Delhi Air Quality Remains In Poor Category Following Cold Morning
aiSummaryBullets: Air quality in Delhi has remained in the poor category for nine consecutive days.
The city recorded its coldest morning of the current season as temperatures dropped.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Criticizes Tamil Nadu CM Joseph Vijay On Deepathoon
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court criticized the Tamil Nadu government regarding a recent Deepathoon order.
State BJP officials have requested an apology from Chief Minister Joseph Vijay following the court ruling.

clusters.headline: Regional Authorities Expand Ethanol Fuel Testing Following Concerns
aiSummaryBullets: Keralam authorities have begun collecting petrol samples from various fuel stations to verify ethanol content following reports from Karnataka.
Karnataka officials conducted tests at 67 locations after finding ethanol levels reaching up to 31% in samples, exceeding the mandated E20 blend.

clusters.headline: TVK MLA V.S. Babu, Who Defeated M.K. Stalin, Has Passed Away
aiSummaryBullets: TVK legislator V.S. Babu has died following a 71-day period of medical treatment.
Babu previously gained political recognition for winning the Kolathur assembly constituency over M.K. Stalin.

clusters.headline: Tata Trusts Challenges N Chandrasekaran Reappointment In Court
aiSummaryBullets: Tata Trusts filed a legal challenge in the Bombay High Court against the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as Tata Sons chairman.
The organization claims the reappointment process violates the internal Articles of Association of the company.

clusters.headline: Ladakh Holds Local Polls Amid Claims Of Boycott By Sonam Wangchuk
aiSummaryBullets: Ladakh recorded a voter turnout of 70% for panchayat elections and 52% for municipal council polls.
These represent the first local body elections held in the region since it was designated a Union Territory in 2019.

clusters.headline: Nandini Curd Price Reduced In Karnataka Following Public Backlash
aiSummaryBullets: The retail price for Nandini curd has been lowered by Rs 2 per kilogram.
The adjustment follows reports of public dissatisfaction regarding earlier cost increases.

clusters.headline: Cyclone Akvan Weakens Into Depression As Heavy Rains Hit Odisha
aiSummaryBullets: Cyclone Akvan has dissipated into a depression, though lingering weather systems continue to bring heavy rainfall to parts of Odisha and West Bengal.
Local administrations in Andhra Pradesh are managing water release from reservoirs following flooding in districts including Srikakulam.

clusters.headline: Centre Confirms Look Out Circular Issued Against Saurav Das
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian government confirmed to the Delhi High Court that a Look Out Circular has been issued against Saurav Das.
Authorities stated that document discrepancies, specifically concerning a passport, may impact his citizenship status.

clusters.headline: West Bengal Cabinet Approves State Renaming To Paschim Banga
aiSummaryBullets: The West Bengal cabinet officially approved the proposal to rename the state to Paschim Banga in both Hindi and English.
Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari is scheduled to introduce the formal motion for this renaming process in the legislative assembly on December 9.

clusters.headline: PM Modi Hailed For Venice Biennale Win As Constitution Day Marked
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recognized India's Venice Biennale pavilion victory while commemorating the nation's Constitution Day.
Diplomatic engagements include discussions with the German Chancellor regarding a pending free trade agreement between India and the European Union.

clusters.headline: Supreme Court Quashes Case Against Rahul Gandhi Over Asset Claims
aiSummaryBullets: The Supreme Court of India canceled Allahabad High Court directives that had requested probes by the CBI and ED into Rahul Gandhi's assets.
Rahul Gandhi recently alleged that his father, Rajiv Gandhi, had his security protection intentionally removed to facilitate his assassination.
